name: Empty Space Filtering (Training-Time Bounding Box)
definition: A preprocessing step that restricts the voxel grid to the scene's bounding box to accelerate training by avoiding computation in empty space.
summary: Empty Space Filtering is a training-time optimization that accelerates neural volume rendering by dynamically deriving a tight bounding box from learned alpha values to skip empty samples, distinguishing itself from static structures by using opacity rather than geometric distance.
